summary: Task 21.2 canonical documentation reconciliation for v1.2. Verified every v1.2-relevant editable current-state surface against the shipped Phases 15-20 work and corrected the stale statements found, with no change to architecture, data-model, or decisions content that was already current. (accepted; `Accepted (v1.2)`)', which also covers the accepted ADR-029 amendment); README.md's F1 known-limitations bullet and the two F1 lines in docs/limitations/archive.md now record the task 14.3 live pinned-host confirmation as completed (`PASS`) instead of 'owned by task 14.3' (the correction V11-G4's disposition called for); the V11-G4 entry and its index row now record that only immutable archived history retains the old phrasing; docs/limitations/00-index.md's intro no longer describes the v1.2 additions as in-flight; docs/architecture/12 no longer labels F3 an 'open limitation'. interpretations.question: How should the V1.2 GOALS pointer name the accepted decision-record set, given ADR-029 was added after the planning-time 'ADR-022 through ADR-028' text?
interpretations.chosen: Changed the pointer to 'ADR-022 onward' (with '(accepted; `Accepted (v1.2)`)'), mirroring the existing V1.1 sentence 'V1.1 decisions are recorded as ADR-016 onward'.
interpretations.basis: The decisions index lists ADR-029 as an accepted v1.2 amendment to ADR-022, so a bounded 'through ADR-028' range would be incomplete; the V1.1 section's 'onward' form is the established in-file convention and stays true if further v1.2 amendments are recorded.
interpretations.impact: Wording only; no scope, status, or requirement change.
